title: Senior Backend Engineer - Python & Distributed Systems
description: We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to architect, build, and maintain high-throughput distributed systems and secure APIs in Python. The candidate will design reliable data models, implement asynchronous pipelines, and enforce strict security guardrails across microservices.

criteria.name: Python & AsyncIO Systems
criteria.description: Demonstrated expertise in Python 3.10+, FastAPI or AsyncIO, concurrency, and high-performance server architecture.

criteria.name: Relational Databases & Performance
criteria.description: Proficiency in PostgreSQL or SQLAlchemy, query optimization, indexing, and transactional integrity.

criteria.name: Security & Defense-in-Depth
criteria.description: Hands-on experience with API security, authentication/authorization, input sanitization, and OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities.

criteria.name: Testing & System Reliability
criteria.description: Rigorous unit testing (pytest), integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
